title: Older than dinosaurs and Himalayas: Why Bengaluru’s 3-billion-year-old Lalbagh Rock is in the news; history of city’s ancient landmark and why citizens are fighting to protect it
description: In Bengaluru, the historic Lalbagh Rock is under siege from a proposed tunnel road project that threatens its integrity. In a display of solidarity, protesters formed a human chain around the rock to advocate for its preservation. A contentious new law permits parkland usage for public utility projects, prompting the government to rethink this contentious legislation amid growing demands from citizens and leaders to halt the tunnel road ramps.
